transcription_of_handwritten_notes__virt.name: Transcription of Handwritten Notes: Virtualization in Cloud Computing

virtualized_environment.name: Virtualized Environment
virtualized_environment.description: An environment allowing multiple operating systems to run simultaneously on a single physical machine via hardware abstraction.

storage_virtualization.name: Storage Virtualization
storage_virtualization.description: The abstraction of physical storage devices into a single, logical storage system managed through software.

storage_area_network.name: Storage Area Network
storage_area_network.description: A network that provides block-level data storage access, used to implement storage virtualization.

para_virtualization.name: Para-virtualization
para_virtualization.description: Virtualization type requiring a modified guest operating system to cooperate with the hypervisor.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.2 §Transcription and Analysis of the Handwritten Notes

full_virtualization.name: Full Virtualization
full_virtualization.description: Virtualization technique allowing unmodified guest operating systems to run using binary translation and hardware support.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.2 §Transcription and Analysis of the Handwritten Notes

hypervisor.name: Hypervisor
hypervisor.description: Software that creates and runs virtual machines, managing hardware and guest operating system execution.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.2 §Transcription and Analysis of the Handwritten Notes

dynamic_cached_translation.name: Dynamic Cached Translation
dynamic_cached_translation.description: Binary translation method used by hypervisors to translate non-virtualizable guest instructions into safe ones on-the-fly.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.2 §Transcription and Analysis of the Handwritten Notes

virtualization.name: Virtualization
virtualization.description: Technology that allows multiple virtual machines to run on a single physical server.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.3 §Transcription of Handwritten Notes: Virtualization in Cloud Computing

type_1_hypervisor.name: Type 1 Hypervisor
type_1_hypervisor.description: Bare-metal hypervisor installed directly on physical hardware.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.3 §Transcription of Handwritten Notes: Virtualization in Cloud Computing

type_2_hypervisor.name: Type 2 Hypervisor
type_2_hypervisor.description: Hosted hypervisor installed on top of an existing host operating system.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.3 §Transcription of Handwritten Notes: Virtualization in Cloud Computing

hypercalls.name: Hypercalls
hypercalls.description: Special software traps used by modified guest operating systems to communicate with the hypervisor.
sources: DocScanner 17-Nov-2025 2-09 pm.pdf p.3 §Transcription of Handwritten Notes: Virtualization in Cloud Computing
